title: DTM: Deterministic Approaches for Black-box Test Suite Minimization with Tree-based Similarity
abstract: arXiv:2609.04205v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Black-box Test Suite Minimization (TSM) techniques reduce testing costs without requiring access to production code. However, existing effective approaches rely on evolutionary search algorithms, introducing non-determinism that produces inconsistent results across runs, undermining reliability in automated testing pipelines. We propose DTM (Deterministic approaches for black-box Test suite Minimization), a framework that ensures deterministic test suite reduction while preserving effectiveness and efficiency. DTM converts test cases into Abstract Syntax Trees and computes pairwise similarities using four tree-based measures. For subset selection, it employs three deterministic algorithms: Modified Minimum Spanning Tree, Spectral Clustering, and Dynamic Programming. translated_title: DTM：基于树相似度的确定性黑盒测试套件最小化方法
translated_abstract: 黑盒测试套件最小化（TSM）技术能够在无需访问生产代码的情况下降低测试成本。然而，现有的有效方法依赖于进化搜索算法，这引入了不确定性，导致多次运行产生不一致的结果，从而削弱了自动化测试流水线的可靠性。我们提出了DTM（确定性黑盒测试套件最小化框架），该框架能够在保持有效性和效率的同时，确保测试套件缩减过程的确定性。DTM将测试用例转换为抽象语法树，并使用四种基于树的度量方法计算成对相似度。在子集选择方面，它采用了三种确定性算法：改进的最小生成树、谱聚类和动态规划。我们在Defects4J的16个Java项目（包含661个缺陷版本）上对DTM进行了评估。实验结果表明，DTM实现了平均0.74的准确率，执行时间为……
tldr: DTM提出了一种基于抽象语法树相似度和三种确定性算法的黑盒测试套件最小化框架，消除了进化搜索算法带来的不确定性，在保证结果可复现的同时实现了高效且有效的测试套件缩减。
en_tdlr: DTM is a deterministic black-box test suite minimization framework that converts test cases into Abstract Syntax Trees with tree-based similarity measures and employs three deterministic subset selection algorithms, eliminating the non-determinism of evolutionary search while preserving effectiveness and efficiency.
